{"id":1961914551,"question_id":4205,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1774711226,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"505 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1961914551/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum XOR Path in a Grid","memory":"393.7 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    void byrec(vector<vector<int>>& grid , int i , int j , int sum , int &mini , vector<vector<vector<int>>>&dp)\n    {\n        int n = grid.size();\n        int m = grid[0].size();\n        \n        if(dp[i][j][sum] != -1) return;\n        \n        dp[i][j][sum] = 1;\n        \n        if(i == n-1 and j== m-1){\n            mini = min(mini , sum);\n            return;\n        }\n\n        if(j+1 < m)\n        {\n            byrec(grid , i , j+1 , sum ^ grid[i][j+1] , mini , dp);\n        }\n        if(i+1 < n)\n        {\n            byrec(grid , i+1 , j , sum ^ grid[i+1][j] , mini , dp);\n        }\n    }\n    \n    int minCost(vector<vector<int>>& grid) {\n        int n = grid.size();\n        int m = grid[0].size();\n        int mini = INT_MAX;\n        vector<vector<vector<int>>>dp(n+1 , vector<vector<int>>(m+1 , vector<int>(1024 , -1)));\n        byrec(grid , 0 , 0 , grid[0][0] , mini , dp);\n        return mini;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-xor-path-in-a-grid","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1882}
